passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the author.
This is a song or poem.
David dedicated these words to God.

passages.text: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
The LORD spoke to David’s Lord.
The LORD gave a command.
He said, “Sit at My right hand.”
He promised to act.
He said, “I will make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
passages.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה׀ לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־ אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
The LORD is God.
The LORD acts with power.
The LORD gives a mighty scepter.
The LORD sends this scepter from Zion.
The LORD commands authority.
The LORD says, “Rule in the midst of your enemies.”
The LORD gives victory even when enemies surround you.
passages.original: מַטֵּֽה־ עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the Messiah.
The Messiah leads God’s people.
Your people will be willing.
This will happen on the day of your power.
Your people will come to you freely.
They will wear holy garments.
They will be dressed in holy splendor.
They will come to you at the very beginning of the day.
They will come from the womb of the dawn.
You will have the dew of your youth.
Your youth will be fresh and many, like the morning dew.
passages.original: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־ קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD made a solemn promise.
The LORD will not change His mind.
You are a priest forever.
You belong to the order of Melchizedek.
passages.original: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה׀ וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־ כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־ דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־ צֶֽדֶק׃

passages.text: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
passages.sermon:
The Lord stands at Your right hand.
The Lord acts with power and authority.
The Lord will crush kings.
He will do this on the day of His wrath.
He will defeat rulers when He is angry.
passages.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל־ יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם־ אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים׃

passages.text: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is the judge of all nations.
He will judge every nation.
He will fill the land with the dead.
He will crush the leaders everywhere.
He will show His power over many lands.
passages.original: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃

passages.text: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
passages.sermon:
The Lord stands at your right hand.
He acts with power and authority.
He will drink from the brook beside the road.
He will refresh Himself as He goes.
Because of this, He will lift up His head.
He will rise in strength and victory.
passages.original: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃
